issues: Recharts warnings 'width(-1) height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' printed on initial mount — cosmetic/perf noise, not blocking. Consider setting explicit min-height on ResponsiveContainer parents.

critical_code_review_comments: dashboard/router.py: PUT /dashboard/preferences uses Pydantic model 'CxoPreferences' (shared with CxO endpoint) — misleading name; consider renaming to DashboardPreferences.

service.py get_extras: 'late' computation uses lexicographic string compare with fallback '9999' — works for ISO YYYY-MM-DD strings but fragile if date format varies. Consider parsing dates for correctness.
DashboardWidgets.jsx: Recharts ResponsiveContainer parents produce width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on first render — cosmetic but adds noise to console.
